source: argparse parser of openadapt-flow 3.3.0 from PyPI (openadapt_flow.__main__.build_parser), long options only. Written by scripts/flow_cli_reference.py snapshot.

help.admit: Turn recordings (or a shadow candidate) into a program with checks: compile, induce, propose checks, stop once for a decision. `admit status` reads the release-admission ledger.
help.admit decide: Show a stopped admission's summary and decide it (a person, at a terminal)
help.admit run: Compile, induce, propose checks, and stop once for a person's decision (the default form: `admit <recordings...>`)
help.admit status: Print admitted vs not-admitted for Flow from the public ledger. Never mints a signature.
help.api: Show or admit API steps compiled from a recording's network capture. None runs until a person admits it.
help.api admit: Admit a bundle's API steps (a person, at a terminal)
help.api propose: Propose the API step again from the recording (after editing the program's checks); drops any earlier admission
help.api show: List a bundle's proposed API steps
help.approve: Record an authenticated approval (approver / resolution / bundle version) authorizing a durably-paused run to resume
help.approve-sanitized: Approve and freeze the exact reviewed derivative as an immutable archive
help.approver-grant: Sign or check a grant that lets named agents or systems answer some saves. Only a registered person signs, at a terminal
help.approver-grant sign: Sign a grant with your policy-signer key
help.approver-grant verify: Check a signed grant against the registry
help.attach-seal: Attach Cloud's signed Execute receipt (the Seal) to a VERIFIED run report
help.bench: Replay a bundle N times against MockMed and aggregate
help.benchmark: Benchmark compiled replay vs. a Claude computer-use agent on the MockMed triage task (agent arm needs an Anthropic API key and costs real money)
help.bind-record-checks: Attach reviewed record checks (system-of-record effect contracts) to a compiled program's save step, in a new bundle; reports which entered fields they compare
help.browser-accessibility: Linux: start Chrome, Chromium, Edge and Brave with their page readable to accessibility tools, so record can read clicks in your everyday browser. Writes your own launcher entries only
help.business-decisions: Customer-runner typed-decision relay; it never resumes or acts.
help.certify: Enforce a policy on a bundle (exits nonzero + reports if it fails); passing means the bundle meets that policy's rules, not that it is safe to run
help.check: Teach a save's read-back by demonstration, and admit it. Nothing confirms a save until a person admits the check.
help.check accept: Use the look-up found after the save (check.proposed.json) as the recording's check.json
help.check admit: Admit a bundle's demonstrated checks (a person, at a terminal)
help.check mark: Write check.json: where the check starts and what it reads
help.cleanup: A clean screen after a halted item: qualify the halt cleanup
help.cleanup qualify: Stop the run after every step on a declared test copy, clean up, and check the start screen comes back
help.compile: Compile a recording into a workflow bundle
help.compile-agent: Run a computer-use agent once against --url (it writes to that app; use a test copy), check the record it wrote, and compile the run into a program that runs with no model calls
help.compose: Author a parent sequencer from named compiled child bundles and a handoff contract. Each child stays bound to its recorded surface. certify/run the output directory.
help.confirm-surfaces: Review the windows a cross-window recording used, and confirm them so the recording can be compiled
help.connect: Claim a one-time browser pairing and store the workspace credential in the OS keychain
help.connector: BYOC connector: enroll this machine with OpenAdapt Cloud and run governed jobs LOCALLY (customer owns the data boundary; PHI stays on this side)
help.connector enroll: Enroll against a mock/development control plane and persist its token
help.connector run: Poll the control plane and run governed jobs until interrupted
help.console: Serve the operator console: a localhost-only web UI over compiled bundles, run reports/halt evidence, and skill-library lineage. Read-only unless --allow-actions; needs `pip install 'openadapt-flow[console]'`
help.countersign: Timestamp, countersign, selectively disclose, and export a dispute dossier for a Seal
help.countersign add: Add a countersign block: field commitments, RFC 3161 timestamp, countersignature
help.countersign close: Close an exception with a disposition signed by a person whose key is pinned
help.countersign disclose: Write a disclosure bundle revealing chosen committed fields
help.countersign dossier: Export one offline-verifiable HTML or zip for a dispute
help.countersign exceptions: List Seals queued on a REFUTED or INDETERMINATE outcome
help.countersign purge: Export, then delete, closed exceptions past their retention period
help.countersign resolve: Resolve an exception with a later verified Seal that links to it
help.countersign timestamp-baseline: Timestamp a baseline read before the executor runs
help.countersign verify: Check a Seal offline and show executor, verification tier, timestamps, and disclosures
help.deferred: Settle saves that a later report confirms (claims acks, exports)
help.deferred settle: Match a report against the waiting checks; expire overdue ones
help.deferred status: A run's outcome after its deferred checks settle
help.demo: See the proof in one command: a checked run and a run whose save fails, side by side on one page (fake clinic data, no AI calls)
help.demo-record: Serve MockMed and record the canonical triage demo
help.disambiguate: Surface compile-time multiple-choice questions for an ambiguous demo and apply the answers as guards/params (ask, don't guess)
help.emit-mcp: Emit a standalone MCP server.py for a bundle
help.emit-skill: Emit an Agent Skills folder for a bundle
help.explain: Plain-language read of a completed run dir: what happened, why the outcome is the safe one, and the next suggested command (read-only)
help.fleet: Fleet drift patch settings: opt-in per app family, roles, and the signed promotion policy. Off for every app by default.
help.fleet allow: Allow patch export and/or import for an app family or domain
help.fleet disallow: Remove an app family or domain from the allowlist
help.fleet policy: Sign or verify the promotion policy
help.fleet policy sign: Sign a policy draft as a policy approver
help.fleet policy verify: Verify the signed policy against roles.json
help.fleet roles: Add a workflow author or a policy approver (never both)
help.fleet status: Show opt-in, roles, policy and trust
help.for-each: Author a DATA-DRIVEN LOOP bundle: wrap an existing single-demonstration bundle's linear body in a LOOP that runs once per record of a worklist (CSV/JSON), binding each record's columns to the workflow's parameters. Emits a program:true bundle the runtime executes bounded, $0, identity-gated and effect-verified per record
help.guard: Guard an agent you already run: attach to its Chromium over CDP, hold each save until the right record is on screen, read it back, and record the run for a compiled program
help.induce: Induce a parameterized PROGRAM bundle from MULTIPLE recordings (multi-trace induction: infer params / loops / branches). Loops: back-to-back repeats and search, open, act, return worklists, including rows that differ; not pagination (a next-page step between rows) or a list nested inside each row. Certified and governed runs refuse a loop that opens each row's record by its values (a record-selecting click) until qualification covers it. REFUSES (nonzero exit, no bundle) when intent is underdetermined, printing a record-next worklist of missing demonstrations
help.intake: Fill a workflow's parameters from a referral PDF, fax image, or email
help.item-approval: List, approve or decline the per-item approval requests a run is waiting on (Desktop's Run it)
help.item-approval approve: Approve one save a person checked in Desktop's Run it
help.item-approval decline: Don't save: decline one save with a closed reason
help.item-approval show: Print the run's approval requests as JSON
help.jit: Review, admit or reject a DRAFT compiled from a computer-use agent run
help.jit admit: Admit a draft whose canary passed: with a registered key, as an agent under a signed policy, or as a person at a terminal
help.jit approver: The signed approver roster: who may approve a save. Every change is signed by an approver already on it
help.jit approver add: Add an approver, signed by an approver on the roster
help.jit approver init: Start the roster with its root approver (once per key directory)
help.jit approver list: Print the approvers the pinned root vouches for
help.jit approver remove: Remove an approver, signed by an approver on the roster
help.jit keygen: Write a new encrypted Ed25519 key
help.jit register: Register a key as a policy signer, admitter key or agent (approvers: jit approver)
help.jit review: Confirm the parameters, then record that you reviewed every step
help.jit sign-policy: Sign an admission policy with your policy-signer key
help.jit status: Print the state, steps and what admission needs
help.known-ids: Admit a system-of-record export as the known-ID list, and check it
help.known-ids confirm: Confirm the export's source and completeness (recorded)
help.known-ids status: Would replay accept this list now?
help.learn: Learn the app's own per-request writes from checked traffic, propose excuses, and approve them into the contracts
help.learn approve: write the approved excuses into contracts
help.learn collect: run a shadow and record each check
help.learn propose: write a proposal a person can read
help.lint: Report a bundle's coverage gaps (unarmed clicks, vacuous postconditions, under-classified risk); exits nonzero by severity
help.local-seal: Offline Seals signed with this machine's key; optional batched timestamps
help.local-seal anchor: Log a Seal's digest in Sigstore Rekor (opt-in; sends a digest and the public key, never report content)
help.local-seal authorize: Run authorizations signed with a person's GitHub SSH key
help.local-seal authorize anchor: Log the authorization's digest in Rekor with the Seal key
help.local-seal authorize create: Write an unsigned authorization and snapshot GitHub's keys
help.local-seal authorize sign: Show what the authorization allows, ask, then sign with ssh-keygen
help.local-seal batch: Fold queued Seals into one Merkle batch (local)
help.local-seal file: Seal any file: a record, an export, an audit report
help.local-seal key: Print the Seal key's public half for pinning
help.local-seal key create: Make a new key at --key file:PATH or keychain:NAME
help.local-seal key pin: Add the Seal key to a pinned key registry
help.local-seal key revoke: Mark a pinned key revoked from a time on
help.local-seal profile: Pseudonymous operator record from anchored Seals (operator-profile.json)
help.local-seal proof: Show the batch, root and inclusion proof for a Seal
help.local-seal public: Write RUN_DIR/public-seal.json: counts, outcomes and digests only, signed, safe to post
help.local-seal submit: Timestamp every unsent batch root (sends one 32-byte digest per batch)
help.local-seal timestamp: One RFC 3161 token for a Seal or a run authorization (sends a 32-byte digest)
help.local-seal verify: Verify a run directory, or a file with --seal
help.login: Validate an ingest token against the hosted control plane and store it in the OS keychain
help.materialize-approved: Rebuild an approved derivative from its archive and approval record
help.narration: Spoken narration for a recording: transcribe on this machine, scrub, line up with the steps (narration.json), or show it
help.narration attach: Transcribe audio on this machine (or read a transcript), scrub it with openadapt-privacy, and line it up with the recording's steps
help.narration show: Print a recording's narration by step
help.no-outbound: Strict no-outbound mode: list and edit the allow list
help.no-outbound allow add: Allow an IP address or private CIDR range by hand
help.no-outbound allow derive: Allow only the host(s) a remote-desktop session profile connects to
help.no-outbound allow list: Show every allowed address and where it came from
help.process: Author a ProcessContract parent from independently admitted capabilities. Each --child needs a --admission envelope. certify/run the output directory; replay refuses it.
help.propose-qualification: Draft a production-shaped qualification contract from a compiled demo. Alias of `qualify propose`.
help.pull: Download a packaged workflow bundle by name
help.push: Upload the exact approved sanitized archive to /api/ingest; raw input is sanitized locally and paused for review
help.qualify: Qualify: before a compiled workflow may run unattended on a real system, run it against the normal case and deliberate faults, and confirm it is verified by reading back the system of record and halts on every fault. Also: create, edit, test, explain and certify the qualification project sealed into a bundle.
help.qualify accept: Confirm every proposed pin in one command after the proposed oracle catches a --break-it fault. Refusing a pin HALTs.
help.qualify add-case: Add a representative or fault case
help.qualify add-requalification: Add a condition that requires this workflow to be requalified
help.qualify admit-local: Sign a local-dev admission for an accepted proposal. The signer cannot enter a production trust map.
help.qualify business-decision: Add, update, or inspect one reviewed finite business decision without editing the workflow manifest
help.qualify campaign: Qualify a bundle from verify.yaml (also the default form: `qualify <bundle> --verify verify.yaml`)
help.qualify certify: Persist a combined qualification and existing-policy decision
help.qualify drills: Add the five readiness drills for the practice case's save and trust this computer's local drill key (a local campaign)
help.qualify from-demo: Propose pins from the demo, accept them, and optionally sign a local-dev admission. After record and compile.
help.qualify judgment-cases: Store or check reviewed local judgment cases; this command never synthesizes an executable rule from examples
help.qualify label: Optionally set, remove, or list presentation-only entity labels
help.qualify label set: Set an optional presentation label for one qualified step
help.qualify propose: Draft application, environment, identity, and effect pins from the compiled demo. Missing pins HALT; nothing is guessed. Runs the proposed oracle against a --break-it fault.
help.qualify run: Import case results produced by the Desktop/local/customer-controlled qualification runner
help.qualify run-case: Run one current qualification case (the practice item or a readiness drill) with Flow-owned Standard authorization
help.qualify set-effect: Assign verification-strength tier to an existing effect
help.qualify set-identity: Set exact/normalized identity fields and their quorum
help.qualify set-risk: Confirm an action's reviewed business-risk classification
help.qualify trust-runner: Trust an Ed25519 qualification-runner public key
help.receipt: Check a signed write receipt offline, or export the keys to check it
help.receipt anchor: Put the receipt's digest in Sigstore Rekor (sends a digest, the public key and a signature; nothing else)
help.receipt keys: Export the public keys a checker pins
help.receipt keys export: Write issuer.pub.pem and log.pub.pem to DIR
help.receipt verify: Check a write receipt against pinned keys
help.reconcile: Check that the EHR, clearinghouse and payer agree on a prior authorization or claim, and report each break
help.record: Record YOUR workflow interactively: a headed browser (--backend web --url), or the operator's real local desktop input through openadapt-capture (--backend windows/macos/linux/rdp/citrix)
help.redact-report: Remove session tokens and credentials from an existing run's report.json, keeping the original locally, so it can be sealed again
help.repair: Governed repair promotion lifecycle: register a proposed (healed or taught) bundle as a CANDIDATE, review its diff, run the replay and fault campaigns, approve (human), stage, canary, and roll back. A proposed bundle NEVER becomes active without this lifecycle. See docs/REPAIR_LIFECYCLE.md
help.repair approve: HUMAN approval gating promotion; refuses unless the diff was reviewed and BOTH campaigns passed. Binds the exact bundle hashes
help.repair campaign: Run a campaign against the candidate's evidence frames: 'replay' (healthy drift battery must all pass) or 'fault' (ambiguity / wrong-entity / stale-target / dialog / verifier-failure frames must all be REFUSED)
help.repair canary: Atomically activate the staged bundle in CANARY mode: a bounded first-N-runs window with per-run verification before full active
help.repair canary-record: Record one canary run from its run directory; any silent-incorrect or verification regression auto-reverts to the prior bundle
help.repair clear-hold: Let repairs of a step apply without a person again after a revert
help.repair list: List candidates and their lifecycle states
help.repair register: Register a (prior, proposed) bundle pair as a repair candidate; refuses (fail closed) any contract weakening without a new qualification revision
help.repair revert: Undo a repair that applied without a person: the prior bundle is active again, and repairs of that step go to a person
help.repair review: Record a human review of the candidate's diff
help.repair rollback: One-command rollback: restore the prior bundle hash as the active pointer
help.repair show: Show a candidate's reviewable diff, campaigns, and state
help.repair stage: Copy BOTH bundles into the store by content hash and re-verify them byte-exact (prior too, so rollback is always local)
help.repair standard-changes: List the repairs that applied without a person (the daily digest)
help.repair status: Show the atomic active-bundle pointer and its lineage
help.replay: Replay a bundle against --url, the config's backend.url, or with --demo-app the bundled demo app
help.report-break: Emit a PHI-free break diagnostic from a halted run's report.json to /api/runs/ingest-report (the recording stays local)
help.report-run: Emit a PHI-free SUCCESS summary from a completed run's report.json to /api/runs/ingest-report (bounded counts, duration, and exact pushed-bundle identity — the recording stays local)
help.resume: Resume a durably-paused run from its last verified checkpoint (never re-running an already-confirmed write)
help.review-sanitized: Review original vs sanitized content in a loopback-only local viewer
help.rollback: Compensating rollback after a stop: qualify it on a test copy (a stop before and after every save)
help.rollback qualify: Stop the run before and after every save on a declared test copy, roll back, and keep the compensations that restore the whole store
help.route: Show which admitted variant a variant set would run for one item (inputs + first screen). Executes nothing.
help.run: Execute a bundle under a deployment config (--config): the replay path wired for a real deployment (backend / effects / actuation / durable / policy) instead of the demo
help.sanitize: Create a verified PHI-scrubbed derivative without modifying the original
help.scaffold-verifier: Build a record check from the reads the app made after the save and test it against injected bad writes (record_check.proposed.yaml + record_check.proof.json; exit 1 when it misses one). Without a read, drafts effect_contract.yaml for a person to fill in. Never approves; refuses demonstrations with no consequential (write) step
help.seal: Encrypt every file of a bundle that can hold patient data with OPENADAPT_BUNDLE_KEY, bind the whole file set to one sealed index, verify it, and publish it atomically at a new path
help.sections: Show a compiled program's named sections (the groups a program map folds), or rename, merge or split them during review
help.serve-execute: Host the public Execute v1 HTTP+MCP contract locally. Receipts are self-signed with a local key. They are not OpenAdapt production Seals. Needs `pip install 'openadapt-flow[execute]'`
help.serve-reward: Score training episodes by reading the system of record through an independent oracle. Receipts are self-signed reward receipts, not Execute Seals. Needs `pip install 'openadapt-flow[reward]'`
help.service: Unattended on-prem service: run, health, restart, egress audit
help.service boot-check: After a restart: wait for the service account to sign in; alert if late
help.service egress-audit: Sample the service process tree's sockets; exit 0 only if no peer is off the machine
help.service health: Check the service; exit 1 when unhealthy
help.service pf: macOS pf rules for the service account (text only)
help.service pf render: Render the anchor from the allow list
help.service restart: Ask the service manager to restart the service
help.service run: Run the queue loop (what launchd/systemd keeps alive)
help.shadow: Check each write an agent makes against the system of record, without blocking or changing it, and write a report
help.silent-saves: Score any GUI agent on injected bad saves: how often it reports success while the record is wrong (source checkout)
help.skill: Bind and qualify a skill pulled from the registry
help.skill bind: Record your values for the skill's contract
help.skill qualify: Qualify the skill on your instance
help.skill status: Whether the pulled skill may run
help.teach: Self-serve HALT -> LEARN: resolve a halted run from a fix demonstration. Induces the correction as a guarded exception branch, gates + validates it, and writes an updated bundle ONLY if it passes (governed refusal otherwise; nonzero exit)
help.teach-authorization: Create, sign or check a teach authorization: what a teaching agent may do, signed by a person with their approver key
help.teach-authorization create: Write the unsigned statement for a spec
help.teach-authorization sign: Show what the statement allows, then sign it with your approver key
help.teach-authorization verify: Check a signed statement against the approver roster
help.teach-branch: Learn a guarded branch from two or more halts resolved the same way. The branch keys on the screen text they share (narrowed by an enum parameter when normal runs show that text too) and is written as a repair candidate that needs approval
help.triage: Order verified saves for review and propose one batch approval
help.triage calibrate: Fit a calibration artifact from labels
help.triage eligibility: Check whether a workflow may switch to only asking about problems: a pinned, eligible calibration artifact and an audit miss-rate bound under the target. Exit 0 eligible, 3 not yet, 2 no evidence.
help.triage estimate: Estimate the miss rate from audit labels
help.triage plan: Write a triage plan; print the review view
help.tutorial: Run the bundled tutorial end to end against a real local system of record: record, compile, certify, govern, and VERIFY the write out of band, then write a shareable local receipt
help.undo: Declared undo steps after a stop: declare, list what a stopped run offers, approve (a person), and run once with verification
help.undo accept: A person approves a proposed undo once (interactive terminal only)
help.undo approve: A person approves one offered undo (interactive terminal only)
help.undo declare: Add a compensating step for one step's effect to a bundle
help.undo list: Show the undos a stopped run offers
help.undo propose: Find an undo for each saving step, verify it on a declared test copy, and write the verified ones as proposals
help.undo run: Run one approved undo once and check it in the system of record
help.validate-hosted: Bind strict lint, policy certification, and a successful local replay to an expiring Cloud challenge and exact approved artifacts. Standard and Regulated activation also binds the sealed governed authorization template.
help.variants: Author or extend a variant set: separately admitted variants of one workflow, routed deterministically before the run
help.variants add: Add one admitted variant, for example a repaired case promoted to a variant
help.variants author: Write variant-set.json from a JSON spec
help.verify-run: Read the system of record and rule on an effect that an agent, script, or person claims it made; writes an unsigned openadapt.effect-receipt/v1. The executor's own record is hashed, never trusted
help.visualize: See what a demonstration compiled INTO: emit a program-graph view of a bundle or a composed parent (child bundles, --after DAG, effect-bound handoffs) as self-contained HTML, Mermaid, or the shared JSON graph spec
